desc: Send NVMe Identify Controller, return result and structure
doc: nvme-intel-lat-stats - Send NVMe Identify Controller, return result and structure

For the NVMe device given, retrieves intel vendor specific latency statistics and provides the result and returned structure.

The <device> parameter is mandatory and may be either the NVMe character device (ex: /dev/nvme0), or a namespace block device (ex: /dev/nvme0n1).

On success, the structure may be returned in one of several ways depending on the option flags; the structure may be parsed by the program or the raw buffer may be printed to stdout.

<dl><dt data-o="">-b, --raw-binary</dt><dd>Print the raw buffer to stdout. Structure is not parsed by program. This overrides the vendor specific and human readable options.</dd></dl> <dl><dt data-o="">-w, --write</dt><dd>Get write statistics. Read statistics are returned by default.</dd></dl>

•Get the read statistics 
# nvme intel lat-stats /dev/nvme0
•Get the write statistics 
# nvme intel lat-stats /dev/nvme0 -w
